basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent college grad exploring the world of Reddit. I enjoy gaming, particularly Dota 2, and I'm a sucker for a good TV series—recently hooked on The White Lotus. Originally from Salt Lake City, I've recently moved to Denver for my first job as a junior data analyst. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm single and love spending time with my dog, Max. I'm still getting the hang of Reddit's vast communities and unwritten etiquette.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Information Systems, which has given me a strong foundation in data analytics and technology. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught, developed through countless hours playing and trading in the Dota 2 community. I'm also exploring fitness and nutrition, but I'm definitely a beginner.
